result: Wrote `index.md` with synthesis prose, plus `cover.svg` via the illustrator. The synthesis surfaces four cross-cutting threads: the ~20-bed walking-distance ceiling that forces months-ahead booking, the Sunday-shut wrinkle that pushes brunch to Lagrasse or Narbonne, the 2026 timing (UNESCO Cathar decision + Lastours' July opening), and the lodging-activity feedback loop where every taxi-range character pick doubles as a day-trip. It closes on the gap none of the children verified — the dinner mechanics (price, pairing, lead time, dress) — pointing the user at the Auberge's phone for the one call that locks the rest.
